title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named public destinations and historic sites along the Ramapo Valley Road (Route 202) corridor near Ramapo College.

cards.title: Ramapo Valley County Reservation
cards.subtitle: Ramapo Valley Road (Route 202) corridor
cards.notes: Use the marked trails for a daylight walk, or consult the county trail information before planning a longer outing.
cards.short_summary: A large Bergen County park with marked hiking trails and Ramapo River access.
cards.evidence_claim: Bergen County identifies this reservation on Ramapo Valley Road and lists marked hiking trails, canoe/kayak access, and access to the Ramapo River.
cards.access_notes: Camping requires a permit; fishing requires an NJ fishing license. Follow posted park rules and trail conditions.

cards.title: Continental Soldier’s Park
cards.subtitle: 550 Ramapo Valley Road corridor
cards.notes: Walk the paved field loop or use the bridges around Lake Henry; bring activity gear if you plan to use courts or fields.
cards.short_summary: A municipal recreation stop with a paved loop, gazebo, playground, and river access.
cards.evidence_claim: Mahwah lists Continental Soldier’s Park at 550 Ramapo Valley Road with a paved path, gazebo, playground, Lake Henry, and Ramapo River access.
cards.access_notes: Use facilities according to municipal rules and any posted field reservations.

cards.title: Hopper Gristmill Site
cards.subtitle: 156 Ramapo Valley Road corridor
cards.notes: Add this historic-site stop to a self-guided local-history route and use the township activity sheet for background.
cards.short_summary: A National Register property included in Mahwah’s children’s self-guided historic-sites tour.
cards.evidence_claim: Mahwah’s Historic Preservation Commission lists the Hopper Gristmill Site at 156 Ramapo Valley Road and includes it among the tour sites.
cards.source_title: Mahwah Historic Preservation Commission: National Register Properties
cards.access_notes: Treat this as a historic-site viewing stop; respect all property boundaries and posted conditions.

cards.title: Hopper–Van Horn House
cards.subtitle: 398 Ramapo Valley Road corridor
cards.notes: Pair this address with the township’s historic-sites materials and view it from public space without entering private property.
cards.short_summary: A named National Register property on the Route 202 corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Mahwah’s Historic Preservation Commission lists the Hopper–Van Horn House at 398 Ramapo Valley Road as a National Register property.
cards.source_title: Mahwah Historic Preservation Commission: National Register Properties
cards.access_notes: View from publicly accessible areas only; do not enter or approach private property.

cards.title: Darlington Schoolhouse
cards.subtitle: 600 Ramapo Valley Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the township’s self-guided history materials to identify the schoolhouse, then continue along the Route 202 corridor.
cards.short_summary: A protected historic schoolhouse listed by Mahwah’s preservation commission.
cards.evidence_claim: Mahwah’s Historic Preservation Commission lists Darlington Schoolhouse at 600 Ramapo Valley Road as a National Register property protected by ordinance.
cards.source_title: Mahwah Historic Preservation Commission: National Register Properties
cards.access_notes: Use public rights-of-way and observe any posted restrictions around the historic property.

cards.title: Crocker-McMillin Mansion
cards.subtitle: Ramapo Valley Road at Campgaw Road corridor
cards.notes: Locate the Ramapo Valley Road and Campgaw Road junction as a history-oriented waypoint; keep all viewing from public areas.
cards.short_summary: A National Register mansion at the Route 202 and Campgaw Road junction.
cards.evidence_claim: Mahwah’s Historic Preservation Commission lists the Crocker-McMillin Mansion at Ramapo Valley Road and Campgaw Road as a National Register property.
cards.source_title: Mahwah Historic Preservation Commission: National Register Properties
cards.access_notes: View from public space only and respect private-property boundaries.

cards.title: Garret Garrison House
cards.subtitle: 980 Ramapo Valley Road corridor
cards.notes: Use this named historic address as a Route 202 photo-reference stop, taking care to remain on public space.
cards.short_summary: The Waternook, a National Register property on the Ramapo Valley Road corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Mahwah’s Historic Preservation Commission lists the Garret Garrison House, also known as Waternook, at 980 Ramapo Valley Road as a National Register property.
cards.source_title: Mahwah Historic Preservation Commission: National Register Properties
cards.access_notes: View from publicly accessible areas only; do not enter private grounds.

cards.title: John Bartholf House
cards.subtitle: 1122 Ramapo Valley Road corridor
cards.notes: Make this the northern history waypoint on a Route 202 route and document the exterior only from permitted public areas.
cards.short_summary: Amberfields, a named National Register property on Ramapo Valley Road.
cards.evidence_claim: Mahwah’s Historic Preservation Commission lists the John Bartholf House, also known as Amberfields, at 1122 Ramapo Valley Road as a National Register property.
cards.source_title: Mahwah Historic Preservation Commission: National Register Properties
cards.access_notes: View from public space only; availability for interior access is not established by the cited source.

cards.entity_name: Continental Soldiers Memorial Highway & W3R-NJ Route
cards.title: Continental Soldiers Memorial Highway
cards.subtitle: Ramapo Valley Road corridor
cards.notes: Look for the official route markers while traveling the corridor and connect the road itself to Mahwah’s Revolutionary War history.
cards.short_summary: A signed historic route designation for Ramapo Valley Road through Mahwah.
cards.evidence_claim: Bergen County states that Ramapo Valley Road was used by Washington’s troops and carries Continental Soldiers Memorial Highway and W3R-NJ Route signs.
cards.source_title: Revolutionary War Sites in Bergen County
cards.access_notes: This is an active road corridor; use designated pedestrian areas and observe traffic rules.

cards.entity_name: Lake Henry and Ramapo River Access at Continental Soldier’s Park
cards.title: Lake Henry and Ramapo River Access
cards.subtitle: Continental Soldier’s Park, Ramapo Valley Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the park’s mulch path and bridges to reach the water-feature area, staying on maintained public paths and observing posted rules.
cards.short_summary: A named water-access feature within the Ramapo Valley Road municipal park.
cards.evidence_claim: Mahwah lists Lake Henry and Ramapo River access, plus a mulch path around the lake with bridges, at Continental Soldier’s Park on Ramapo Valley Road.
cards.access_notes: Stay on maintained public paths; follow municipal signage and water-safety guidance.
